test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if ‘PDFJARS’ is written as ‘OCELZQR’ and ‘MHCXBTU’ is written as ‘LGBZAST’, how will ‘ZVDGENQ’ be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First three letters and last three letters → (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• ‘PDFJARS’ is written as ‘OCELZQR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d79652e6cc46e6d08701d114a54479a59eb9dc5a76699836bbd45f37d65b5639.png] 

And,

 
• ‘MHCXBTU’ is written as ‘LGBZAST’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0e722e3a0b7a55072b7e14b2d188ddd8b1dd54c150c53bbe02be05857d434c8.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘ZVDGENQ’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcd709b5569b4c4fd15980aa6fa75cd20b06bf6623724f103148c1b326fecda1.png] 

​Hence, the correct answer is **"****YUCIDMP"**.

62
